variables.name: ANDROID_AVD_HOME
variables.description: Optional override for the Android Virtual Device directory.

variables.name: ANDROID_RECEIVER_AVD
variables.description: AVD name assigned to the receiver role.

variables.name: ANDROID_RECEIVER_PORT
variables.description: ADB console port assigned to the receiver role.

variables.name: ANDROID_SDK_ROOT
variables.description: Android SDK root used by legacy and CI tooling.

variables.name: ANDROID_SENDER_AVD
variables.description: AVD name assigned to the sender role.

variables.name: ANDROID_SENDER_PORT
variables.description: ADB console port assigned to the sender role.

variables.name: ASC_ISSUER_ID
variables.description: App Store Connect API issuer identifier.

variables.name: ASC_KEY_ID
variables.description: App Store Connect API key identifier.

variables.name: ASC_KEY_PATH
variables.description: Path to an untracked App Store Connect .p8 private key.

variables.name: GH_TOKEN
variables.description: GitHub CLI token for non-interactive hosts; local keyring auth may replace it.

variables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
variables.description: GitHub Actions job token injected by GitHub.

variables.name: IOS_DEVICE_UDID
variables.description: UDID of the explicitly selected physical iOS device.

variables.name: JAVA_HOME
variables.description: JDK installation root used by Android tooling.

variables.name: MATCH_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password protecting a fastlane match certificate repository.

variables.name: MCP_TUNNEL_ENDPOINT
variables.description: HTTPS endpoint assigned to a Secure MCP Tunnel.

variables.name: NL_MODEL
variables.description: Model identifier selected by natural-language browser tooling.

variables.name: NL_PROVIDER
variables.description: Natural-language provider selector such as ollama or gemini.

variables.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
variables.description: Sentry release and source-map upload token.
